newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nomura to lead USS1 bln note programme.
newsitem.headline: Nomura to lead USS1 bln note programme.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co unit Nomura Singapore Ltd will lead manage a US$1 billion Asian medium term note programme for Marubeni Corp 's MIF Asia Ltd, MIF Asia said on Tuesday.
The net proceeds from each issue of notes will be applied by MIF Asia for non-Singapore dollar denominated activities.
A MIF Asia statement said the Japan Bond Research Institute had rated the programme AA- and in-principle approval had been received from the Stock Exchange of Singapore to list the notes.

MIF Asia was set up in 1995 as part of Marubeni's global finance network to integrate four major financial markets -- Japan, the United States, Europe and Asia -- and is primarily responsible for financial services to Marubeni subsidiaries and affiliates in Asia, the statement said.
